actions.title: DON'T TAKE THE BOOKS
pages:
11/07

Take the batteries.
Take the fuel.
Take anything sealed.
Burn what we can't carry if you have to.

Leave the route books.

People still come here looking for names.
Maybe somebody will again.

— Helen
actions.purpose: Последняя просьба Хелен сохранить имена пропавших в архиве Smokey’s.

actions.title: RADIO WATCH
pages:
RADIO WATCH
Updated 10/31

0800 — WEST POINT
1200 — SOUTH ROAD
1800 — WEST POINT
2100 — LISTEN ONLY

Keep transmissions short.
Names once.
Location never twice.

If they ask where Smokey's is, give the road marker, not the building.
If the same voice asks three times — shut it down.
actions.purpose: Расписание радиообмена Томаса, по которому видно работу северных связных маршрутов.

actions.title: LAST BOARD
pages:
11/07 — BEFORE WE LEAVE

Drain the generator.
Take both good batteries.
Food from upstairs first.
Leave the hand pump.
Leave one medical box.
Route books stay.

White van stays.
Put two road bags in the back.
Spare key in the glovebox.
Lock it.

Anybody coming back from the shop:

You waited for us once.
We waited six days for you.

Take the van and go north.
Don't follow us.

— Helen
actions.purpose: План организованной эвакуации 7 ноября, оставленный для пропавшей группы мастерской.
